<compartment start="1" end="14" title="Fail-closed tenant context" episode_type="design,feature" importance="96">
<p1>
U: "no cross-tenant read should ever get 'best effort' -- fail closed, even in dev"

We rewired Acorn Suite's tenant boundary in apps/api/src/middleware/tenantBoundary.ts and packages/auth/src/sessionClaims.ts. The old path let dashboard routes recover a missing JWT tenant_id from orgSlug or X-Org-Slug, which made stale bookmarked URLs dangerous. U: "if the header lies, don't heal it with orgSlug"

The first patch kept a compatibility fallback for old dashboard links, but the user pushed back and we changed requireTenantContext(req) to treat JWT tenant_id as the only tenant authority. REST route wrappers and GraphQL createContext now share the same helper, Prisma filters receive tenantId only from that context, and platform_support is modeled as a service actor instead of a wildcard tenant. Added apps/api/test/tenant-boundary/rest.spec.ts and graphql.spec.ts using acme_lab and beta_works fixtures. Commit a91f2c8.
</p1>
<p2>
Acorn Suite tenant isolation now fails closed: U: "no cross-tenant read should ever get 'best effort' -- fail closed, even in dev". requireTenantContext(req) is the shared REST/GraphQL entry point and rejects missing JWT tenant_id instead of recovering from orgSlug or X-Org-Slug.
</p2>
<p3>
Acorn Suite made JWT tenant_id the single tenant authority across REST, GraphQL, and Prisma; slug/header fallback was removed to prevent cross-tenant reads.
</p3>
<p4>requireTenantContext; JWT tenant_id only; acme_lab beta_works</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<PROJECT_RULES>
* All tenant-scoped Acorn Suite handlers must call requireTenantContext(req) and fail closed; do not recover missing tenant_id from orgSlug or X-Org-Slug.
* Acorn Suite auth changes must include both REST and GraphQL tenant-boundary tests before merge.
</PROJECT_RULES>
<ARCHITECTURE>
* Acorn Suite uses JWT tenant_id as the single tenant authority so REST, GraphQL, and Prisma filters share one isolation model.
* Platform support bypass is modeled as a service actor, not as a tenant wildcard.
</ARCHITECTURE>
<CONSTRAINTS>
* X-Org-Slug and route orgSlug are presentation hints only; using them as tenant authority can produce cross-tenant reads when cached dashboard URLs are stale.
</CONSTRAINTS>
<CONFIG_VALUES>
* Acorn Suite tenant-boundary fixtures live under apps/api/test/tenant-boundary/ and use seed tenants acme_lab and beta_works.
</CONFIG_VALUES>
<NAMING>
* The shared auth helper is named requireTenantContext; "resolveTenantMaybe" was rejected because it implied fallback behavior.
</NAMING>
</facts>
<events>
<trajectory_correction at_compartment="1">
  <summary>Removed tenant fallback after user rejected compatibility recovery.</summary>
  <before_strategy>Keep an orgSlug/X-Org-Slug fallback for old dashboard links when JWT tenant_id was absent.</before_strategy>
  <correction_source>user</correction_source>
  <correction_signal>U: "if the header lies, don't heal it with orgSlug"</correction_signal>
  <after_strategy>Require JWT tenant_id everywhere and return 403 when it is absent or inconsistent.</after_strategy>
  <evidence>The final implementation made requireTenantContext(req) the only REST/GraphQL tenant entry point.</evidence>
</trajectory_correction>
</events>
<user_observations>
* User states security boundaries as hard constraints and prefers conservative fail-closed behavior over compatibility fallback.
</user_observations>

<compartment start="1058" end="1187" title="Idempotency strategy for Stripe webhook handlers" episode_type="design,bug" importance="79">
<p1>
Duplicate charge events from Stripe were producing duplicate invoice rows in our system. Root issue: we'd been keying our internal idempotency on the request signature header, but Stripe's docs are clear that signature is per-DELIVERY, not per-EVENT — Stripe retries the same event with a fresh signature and timestamp.

Redesigned. Idempotency now keys on the Stripe `event.id` itself (format: `evt_*`). New table `stripe_event_idempotency(event_id text primary key, first_seen_at timestamptz, response_body bytea, response_status int)`. Handler flow: open transaction → INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING → if no row inserted, return the stored response; else process and store the response inside the same transaction. TTL on rows is 90 days (Stripe's documented retry-then-give-up window is 3 days, so 90 is generous).

U: don't be clever about the TTL, just set it long enough that we never see a Stripe replay miss

The handler is wrapped in `internal/billing/webhooks/idempotent.go` and the table lives in the `billing` schema. Removed the old signature-based dedup entirely — keeping both would mask routing bugs.
</p1>
<p2>
Stripe webhook idempotency rebuilt around `event.id` (not delivery signature). Table `billing.stripe_event_idempotency` stores event_id, first_seen, response body+status. Inside one transaction: INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, replay stored response if not inserted, else process+store. 90-day TTL. U: "don't be clever about the TTL, just set it long enough that we never see a Stripe replay miss." Old signature-based dedup deleted.
</p2>
<p3>
Stripe webhook idempotency keys on event.id with stored response replay; old signature-based dedup removed.
</p3>
<p4>
billing.stripe_event_idempotency; key = event.id; TTL 90d
</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<PROJECT_RULES>
* Idempotency for any external webhook source must key on the provider's event identifier (e.g. Stripe `event.id`), never on delivery-level signatures or timestamps. Stored response body+status is returned on duplicate.
</PROJECT_RULES>
<CONSTRAINTS>
* Stripe webhook signatures and timestamps are regenerated per delivery attempt — they CANNOT be used as idempotency keys because retries of the same event produce different signatures.
</CONSTRAINTS>
<ARCHITECTURE>
* Webhook idempotency uses a write-through pattern: the handler's full response is captured inside the same transaction that records the event_id, so replays return byte-identical responses without re-executing side effects.
</ARCHITECTURE>
<CONFIG_VALUES>
* `billing.stripe_event_idempotency` table; primary key on `event_id`; row TTL 90 days; wrapper in `internal/billing/webhooks/idempotent.go`.
</CONFIG_VALUES>
<NAMING>
* Webhook idempotency table is `billing.stripe_event_idempotency`. Future provider-specific tables follow the pattern `<provider>_event_idempotency`.
</NAMING>
</facts>
<events>
<causal_incident at_compartment="8">
  <summary>Duplicate invoices were being created when Stripe retried webhook deliveries.</summary>
  <affected_surface>provider_sdk</affected_surface>
  <symptom>Customer support reported multiple customers seeing duplicate invoices for the same charge event.</symptom>
  <cause_summary>Our dedup keyed on the webhook signature header, but Stripe regenerates that per delivery attempt — retries bypassed dedup.</cause_summary>
  <disposition>fixed</disposition>
  <evidence>Stripe dashboard event log showed multiple delivery attempts of the same `evt_*` ID, each producing a new invoice row in our DB.</evidence>
  <fix_summary>Reimplemented idempotency on `event.id`; added write-through response storage; deleted signature-based dedup.</fix_summary>
</causal_incident>
</events>
</compartment_examples_from_other_projects>

<compartment start="719" end="729" title="Oracle 二轮 FAIL 收窄至递归自由结构：扩展 KnownKeyDoc 并派三道" episode_type="investigation,design,feature" importance="70">
<p1>
Oracle 对 `9b5ed34` 判 **FAIL**，但明确**原 7 项全部闭合**（逐条给 `文件:行`），第 8/10 项决策（清 `$ref`、不重跑 41 项工装）判可接受。新发现 1 BLOCKER + 2 IMPORTANT + 1 SUGGESTION，核心是 `knownKeys` 只能表达一层类型、`keySchema()` 把任何 `array` 生成为 `array<string>`（`ApiDocsApplier.java:646-669`；`CareApiDocs.java:917-935,955-985`），而真实 `CarePlanFullView.plan.steps` 是 `array<object{region,parameters}>`（`CarePlanProjection.projectSteps()`）、两个 `planExecution.steps` 同病、`ErrorBody.details.fields`/`missingRanges` 实为对象数组 ⇒ 机器 schema 与真实响应冲突、会误导 Swagger UI 与代码生成器，违反"大 JSON 必须明确结构及可扩展边界"。另：门禁只扫 component 直接属性、嵌套空对象漏检；required 交叉校验只覆盖请求不覆盖响应 DTO；`metrics.value` 文案自相矛盾。Oracle 给 6 条一次性判据 + **轮次边界声明**（下一轮只审递归结构、响应 required 门禁与那条负向测试，不再因措辞发起轮次），并列 10 项须设备团队冻结的协议项。

我亲自取证确认 BLOCKER 成立且更精确：根因是 `keySchema()` 的一层 DSL（`case "array" -> new ArraySchema().items(new StringSchema())`），**只影响自由结构对象内部的键**；顶层数组型自由字段（`HeartbeatBody.incidents`、`SkinReportView.metrics`）反而正确（`items.type=object` 且键齐全）。实测错误清单：`plan.steps`×3、`ErrorBody.details.fields`（我的 `CommonEnvelopeApiDocs`）、`missingRanges`（我的）、`plan.parameters`×3 空映射、`incidents[].detail` 空壳。契约**没有** `CarePlan`/`PlanStep`/`Metric`/`Incident` schema ⇒ plan 侧权威源是 `CarePlanProjection` 代码、`missingRanges` 侧是契约 `MissingRange`。

我扩展**自己拥有的冻结接口**：`KnownKeyDoc` 改 7 组件 + 加法 `default structuredKeys()`（保持 16 处 `new FreeFormDoc(...)` 零破坏）。过程中犯一个真实 Java 错误——试图给 record 加可变私有字段 `valueSchema`，被 `Instance fields may not be declared in a record class` 拒绝，遂把"动态映射的值结构"改为第 7 个组件 `additionalPropertiesSchema`。另加 `"any"` 类型（`projectParameter` 允许标量**或** `{value,unit}` 联合，硬塞任一具体类型都是失真）。修**我自己的** `CommonEnvelopeApiDocs`：`details.fields` 按 `MemberAccessGrantController:209` 建模为开放对象（部分生产者如 `CareBigints:50` 只给 `field` 不给 `reason`）、`missingRanges` 按契约 `MissingRange` 建模为封闭 `{from,to}`。`JAVAC_RC=0`。

C4 那条 SUGGESTION 的逐字原文确为自相矛盾（"number…数值/文本类型未冻结"）；真相是上游 `assessment_analyze.py:645-648` 强制 `value` 为 int/float（排除 bool）且须落在核准范围，违约即 `PROVIDER_CONTRACT_VIOLATION` 终态 ⇒ 类型必然是数值，未冻结的是语义/单位/范围。另发现 Oracle 未点名的引擎缺陷：`SkinReportListItem.reportSummary` 节点缺 `"type":"object"`（清 `$ref` 后未补 type），一并修。

派三条道（fix-9 引擎+门禁、fix-7 C3、fix-6 C2，写域互斥、全禁 mvn）；C4 单字符串我自己改。C2 交付 `IdentityDeviceApiDocs` 的 `structuredKeys()`：`HeartbeatBody.incidents[].detail` 用 `opaqueObject`——取证 `GimbalHeartbeatService:281-283`（`instanceof Map` 原样透传）、`:304-305`（非对象落空对象），对比同级 `code/state/cleared/severity` 都有显式读取、唯 `detail` 只判类型不读键；契约 `:2173-2176` `additionalProperties:true` + `x-detail: skeleton` ⇒ 内部键未冻结且不被服务端解析，选 `opaqueObject` 忠实。C3 交付 `CareApiDocs` 的 `structuredKeys()`：`steps`→`array<closedObject{region,parameters}>`、`parameters`→`mapOf`——取证 `CarePlanProjection.projectStep():152-175`（只留 region+parameters、其余丢弃）、`projectParameters():192-204`、`projectParameter():206-236`（标量原样返回 或 只留 `{value,unit}`），并用运行时证据 `cc-05-bodies.json`（`"parameters":{"intensity":"3"}` 裸标量、`"vendor_debug":{"unit":"level","value":"3"}` 对象）证明两分支都真实存在。两条道都指出同一个须由我裁定的接缝：引擎对"数组字段 items 键"与 `any` 的落地口径必须与目录假设一致，否则"目录写了但生成文档没变"的静默失效。

趁三道在飞，补 `B-oracle.md` 两轮 FAIL 记录（R1@`fb342a6`、R2@`9b5ed34`）与 `B.md` 14.9（含我超出 Oracle 的两点补充取证、我在 record 里加实例字段的错误、我对判据⑥的纠正与主动规避的"静默降级为 string"风险）。
</p1>
<p2>
Oracle 对 `9b5ed34` 判 FAIL 但收窄：原 7 项全闭合，新 BLOCKER 是 `knownKeys` 一层 DSL 把任何 `array` 生成为 `array<string>`，而 `plan.steps` 实为 `array<object{region,parameters}>`、`ErrorBody.details.fields`/`missingRanges` 为对象数组 ⇒ 机器 schema 与真实响应冲突。我另发现 Oracle 未点名的 `reportSummary` 缺 `type=object` 一并修。扩展自己拥有的冻结接口：`KnownKeyDoc` 7 组件 + 加法 `structuredKeys()`（不破坏 16 处 `new FreeFormDoc(...)`；record 不能加实例字段，值结构走第 7 组件）；加 `any` 类型；修我的 `CommonEnvelopeApiDocs`（`details.fields` 开放对象、`missingRanges` 封闭 `{from,to}`）；`metrics.value` 按上游 `assessment_analyze.py:645-648` 强制 int/float 改写。派 fix-9/fix-7/fix-6 三道（全禁 mvn）；C2 用 `opaqueObject` 定义 `detail`（服务端仅 `instanceof Map` 透传、不解析键）、C3 用递归结构定义 `steps`/`parameters`（`CarePlanProjection` 取证），两道都提示引擎落地口径须一致否则静默失效。更新 `B-oracle.md`/`B.md` 14.9。
</p2>
<p3>
Oracle 二轮 FAIL 收窄到"递归自由结构"：我扩展 `KnownKeyDoc`/`structuredKeys()` 递归接口、修 `reportSummary` 缺 type、并派三道整改；核心是 `array<string>` 与真实对象数组冲突，且两条目录道都指向引擎落地口径须一致的接缝。
</p3>
<p4>
9b5ed34 Oracle 二轮 FAIL; knownKeys 一层 DSL → array<string>; KnownKeyDoc 7 组件 + structuredKeys(); opaqueObject(detail); CarePlanProjection steps/parameters
</p4>
</compartment>

<compartment start="730" end="743" title="Swagger 第四轮：中央验证脚本自测与引擎接缝裁定" episode_type="investigation,design" importance="56">
<p1>
C2（`IdentityDeviceApiDocs`）与 C3（`CareApiDocs`）两道交付后，都指向同一个必须由我实测裁定的接缝风险：C2 把 `HeartbeatBody.incidents` 的内层键理解为**数组元素的键**，C3 用 `KnownKeyDoc("any", …)` 表达 `projectParameter` 的标量或 `{value,unit}` 联合，两者都声明"若引擎口径不同请统一调整"。即引擎对"数组字段 items 键"与 `any` 的落地口径必须与目录假设一致，否则会出现"目录写了但生成文档没变"的静默失效，不能靠任一方自报。

我先写好中央验证脚本 `verify-r4.py`（放 `.coordination/B-work/swagger-docs/`，与任何道不重叠），并拿上一版真实抓取 `r3-api-docs.json` 自测判别力——一个对旧文档全绿的脚本等于没有脚本。首次自测**脚本自身崩溃**：`prop(prop(holder, field), "steps")` 把属性节点（dict）当 schema 名传回 `prop()` → `TypeError: unhashable type: 'dict'`。修法是新增 `sub(node, key)` 在已取得的属性节点内下钻一层并改两处调用点。修正后判别力测试 **34 PASS / 22 FAIL**，22 个失败项恰好是待修清单（9× `plan.steps`、3× `parameters` 的 additionalProperties、5× `details.fields/missingRanges`、递归扫描精确逮到 4 个空壳 = `incidents[].detail` + 3 个 `plan.parameters`、2× 缺 `type=object`、1× `metrics.value` 矛盾文案），已闭合项全 PASS。

自测还暴露我给 fix-9 的一条判据**无法实现**：仅凭生成文档无法判别"目录把对象数组声明成 `array<string>`"（DSL 产出的 `array<string>` 与合法字符串数组在输出中完全同形）。有判别力的做法是把约束前移到引擎 fail-fast——禁止 `knownKeys` 裸 `array`/`object` 前缀、要求显式 `array<string>`、嵌套形状一律走 `structuredKeys`。用非打断的 `task_message` 排队投递修正。同时我主动规避一个风险：若 fix-9 未实现显式前缀而我先改目录，`keySchema` 会落到 `default -> StringSchema()` 把字段**静默降级为 string**（比原缺陷更糟），故在其确认前不动目录文件。取得权威取证：10 处裸前缀（`AssessmentApiDocs:596` headline_metrics、`CareApiDocs:926/961/976` regions ×3、`CommonEnvelopeApiDocs:154/166/181/201/206`、`IdentityDeviceApiDocs:765` detail）。

Board 随后标 fix-9 `timed_out` 并列入 Reusable，但 `task_status` 返回 `state: busy`、`idle_for_seconds: 4`、`possibly_stuck: false`，磁盘吻合（`ApiDocsApplier.java` 04:28:37 写入 46850→57938 字节、`ApiDocsCoverageIT.java` 04:29:20 30907→38801）⇒ **第六次假信号**，我不恢复、不改道、不 revive、不回退。它已收到并实现我排队的判据修正（javadoc `:787-790` 明写"裸 `array`/`object` 前缀已废弃并 fail fast：引擎无法从输出判别'本应是对象数组'还是合法字符串数组"），递归构建也已落地（`knownKeySchema(doc, fieldPath)` `:605`、`any` 分支 `:611`、嵌套 properties 递归 `:621`、`additionalPropertiesSchema` `:627`；门禁侧 `APPROVED_OPAQUE_FIELDS` `:58`、`isUnstructuredObject` `:279`、`crossCheckContractRequired` `:306/:469`）。

我读引擎后确认接缝已被 fix-9 主动化解、两条目录道假设都正确：`applyFreeForm` 明确跳过将被 `structuredKeys` 覆盖的一层 DSL 键（`if (structuredKeys.containsKey(k.getKey())) continue;`，注释写"避免对其做已废弃前缀校验"）⇒ C2 的 `"detail", "object，…"` 不会 fail fast；数组型自由字段语义固化为"knownKeys/structuredKeys 描述的是**元素对象**的键"（`prop.setType("array"); prop.setItems(struct)`）；`any`（type 为 null/空）不写 `type` 关键字、仅 description；我发现的 `type=object` 缺陷已修；`keySchema` 精确语法 `array<string|integer|number|boolean>`，裸 `array`/`object` → fail fast。据此把待改清单从 10 收敛到 **5 处真实会 fail fast**（我的 `conflictingRecordIds`、C4 的 `headline_metrics`、C3 的 `regions` ×3，两处文案相同用 replaceAll）并全部改为 `array<string>`；预检剩余 5 处安全（`CommonEnvelopeApiDocs:154/166` 是 `KnownKeyDoc.array(...)` 的描述文本、不经 `keySchema`；`:181/206` 与 `IdentityDeviceApiDocs:765` 是 knownKeys 条目但被各自 `structuredKeys()` 覆盖 ⇒ 引擎按 `:545-548` 跳过）。我**决定不清理这 3 条被跳过的死文案**——跳过是刻意且有注释的，若将来删掉覆盖，裸前缀 fail fast 正是期望行为；在 fix-9 在飞时扩大改动面只会污染最终 diff。fix-9 仍在活跃写入（`ApiDocsApplierTest` 58353 字节@04:30:27、`ApiDocsCoverageIT` 42731@04:31:39）⇒ 不构建。更新 `B.md` 14.9 与运行时待办为权威记录。
</p1>
<p2>
